description.value: Marulilu Cafe is a Japanese classic-style cafe on West Broadway in Vancouver, one minute's walk from Broadway-City Hall Station. It serves traditional Japanese comfort food popular in Japan — including Omu-Rice, Curry-Rice, Onigiri, and Donburi — alongside coffee and tea. Online ordering for counter pickup is available, making it a convenient stop on a busy cycling corridor.
